about.title: Aviation, optimization and software, in that order.
body: I'm an aerospace engineer from URJC, Air Navigation track. For over three years at Cisneria Engineering I've worked on the planning logic of an aircraft assignment system used in production by airlines, including the TAP Air Portugal rollout.

My thesis, a MILP model that generates aircraft rotations with sustainability criteria, was graded 9.5/10. I rely on Python, data and AWS, and I want to steer my career towards aerospace and defense engineering: systems integration, simulation, UAV and air navigation.
about.hobbies: Outside work: Formula 1, the mountains, simulators, 3D printing, and volunteering as a youth leader at Salesianos Parla.

jobs.role: Project Engineer · Airline Operations Planning & Optimization
items: Planning logic of aircraft assignment software used in production by airlines: planning rules, operational data validation and automation of tactical planning.
TAP Air Portugal technical rollout: data integration, business rules, backend services and go-live support.
Python services and REST APIs (Flask, PostgreSQL) tested with Pytest: 85% coverage across the microservices.
Daily operation of AWS production infrastructure for two clients (ECS Fargate, RDS, S3, CloudWatch) and cost inventory.
Designed and optimized a single-seater's rear wing with SolidWorks and CFD (Ansys Fluent).
Mentoring youth groups. I built HERES, their organisation platform.

education.note: Preparing AZ-900 and AWS Cloud Practitioner.
